signal.component_anomalies: upright_penalty=-5.67 dominates (5.8x larger than all other components combined). Only fires 43.9% of steps but when active the magnitude is catastrophic. height_penalty=-0.03 is negligible despite w_h=10.0 — z thresholds rarely breached.

signal.signal_quality: Deadly coupling: upright_penalty (w_up=5.0, hinge on up_z<0.7) punishes any tilt. Agent can't explore forward motion (forward=+0.22 active only when health_gate>0), but staying upright enough to unlock forward appears unreachable. The gate blocks the only positive signal.

args.key_findings: mean_eval_reward=0.72 but all 20 episodes terminated (mean length=11.8 steps). Generated reward mean=-5.58, far worse than original_env_reward=-0.97. The upright_penalty component dominates at -5.67 (43.9% nonzero), swamping forward reward at +0.22. The policy is dying from orientation collapse before forward can train.
args.component_anomalies: upright_penalty: mean=-5.67, nonzero_rate=43.9% — fires in under half of steps but magnitude is catastrophic when active (quadratic hinge below up_thr=0.7). forward: mean=+0.2225, nonzero_rate=56.9% — health gate kills forward reward ~43% of time. height_penalty: -0.032 — negligible, so z-gate is not the bottleneck; orientation is.
args.training_dynamics: No checkpoint snapshots available for temporal analysis. Static evidence shows upright_penalty (w_up=5.0) creates a negative reward chasm: below up_thr=0.7 the penalty activates, but forward only activates above up_z=0.5 via gate_up. This creates a 0.5-0.7 dead zone where penalty fires but forward is gated off.
args.signal_quality: The upright_penalty quadratic hinge with w_up=5.0 and up_thr=0.7 creates an unreachable attractor: the agent never achieves stable upright posture. The forward signal (w_fwd=1.0, gated) is too weak to overcome the penalty. Episodes truncate at 11.8 steps — too short for forward reward to accumulate meaningful gradient vs penalty dominance.
